mapper.select: SELECT ATCH_FILE_SN, FILE_SCOPE_CD, ATCH_VISBLTY_CD, TRGT_TYPE, TRGT_ID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_TYPE_CD, STRG_KEY, URL_ADDR, MIME_TYPE_NM, EXTN_NM, FILE_SZ, SCAN_STTS_CD, SCAN_DT, ATCH_STTS_CD, TEMP_EXPIRE_DT, LINKED_DT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN, DEL_YN FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} AND FILE_SCOPE_CD IN ('PUBLIC_IMAGE', 'PROFILE_IMAGE', 'REVIEW_IMAGE') AND ATCH_STTS_CD = 'LINKED' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT ATCH_FILE_SN, FILE_SCOPE_CD, TRGT_TYPE, TRGT_ID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_TYPE_CD, STRG_KEY, URL_ADDR, MIME_TYPE_NM, EXTN_NM, FILE_SZ, SCAN_STTS_CD, SCAN_DT, ATCH_STTS_CD, TEMP_EXPIRE_DT, LINKED_DT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN, DEL_YN FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} AND FILE_SCOPE_CD = 'PUBLIC_IMAGE' AND ATCH_STTS_CD = 'LINKED' AND DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT ATCH_FILE_SN, FILE_SCOPE_CD, ATCH_VISBLTY_CD, TRGT_TYPE, TRGT_ID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_TYPE_CD, STRG_KEY, URL_ADDR, MIME_TYPE_NM, EXTN_NM, FILE_SZ, SCAN_STTS_CD, SCAN_DT, ATCH_STTS_CD, TEMP_EXPIRE_DT, LINKED_DT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN, DEL_YN FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ATCH_FILE SET ATCH_STTS_CD = 'LINKED', TRGT_TYPE = 'INQR', TRGT_ID = #{trgtId}, ATCH_VISBLTY_CD = #{atchVisbltyCd}, LINKED_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} AND FILE_SCOPE_CD = 'INQR_ATTACH' AND ATCH_STTS_CD = 'TEMP' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND RGTR_SN = #{mdfrSn} AND TRGT_TYPE IS NULL AND TRGT_ID IS NULL AND (TEMP_EXPIRE_DT IS NULL OR TEMP_EXPIRE_DT >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE ATCH_FILE SET DEL_YN = 'Y', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN = #{atchFileSn} AND FILE_SCOPE_CD = 'INQR_ATTACH' AND ATCH_STTS_CD = 'TEMP' AND TRGT_TYPE IS NULL AND TRGT_ID IS NULL AND TEMP_EXPIRE_DT < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT ATCH_FILE_SN, FILE_SCOPE_CD, ATCH_VISBLTY_CD, TRGT_TYPE, TRGT_ID, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, STRG_TYPE_CD, STRG_KEY, URL_ADDR, MIME_TYPE_NM, EXTN_NM, FILE_SZ, SCAN_STTS_CD, SCAN_DT, ATCH_STTS_CD, TEMP_EXPIRE_DT, LINKED_DT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN, DEL_YN FROM ATCH_FILE WHERE FILE_SCOPE_CD = 'INQR_ATTACH' AND TRGT_TYPE = 'INQR' AND TRGT_ID = #{trgtId} AND ATCH_STTS_CD = 'LINKED' AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY ATCH_FILE_SN
